slides.texte_overlay:
cheat codes for your 20s (that
will help you get dangerously ahead)

say yes to the hard project

volunteer for the work nobody wants at your first jobs. hard projects teach you more in three months than easy ones do in three years, and people notice.

build one real friendship a year

invest in one new deep friendship every year. by thirty you'll have a circle that knows you, supports you, and opens doors you didn't even know existed.

save before you spend

put a small amount aside the day you get paid, before anything else. the habit matters far more than the amount, and your future self will thank you every month.

learn outside your job

spend 5 minutes a day learning about the world beyond your work: history, art, science. people who know a bit about everything become the most interesting in any room.

move your body daily

walk, run or train every day, even for twenty minutes. the energy, sleep and mood you build in your twenties are the foundation for everything that comes after.
